title: fix: separate Polli maintainer and read-only commands
author: Itachi-1824
pr_body_excerpt:
- Restricts `!polli` to voodoohop, ElliotEtag, Itachi-1824, and Circuit-Overtime using immutable GitHub IDs.
- Adds `!askpolli` for read-only PR questions from the existing contributor allowlist, including fisventurous.
- Separates read-only inference from reply publication and uses bounded GitHub context with direct model inference.
- Adds authorization and workflow regression checks to CI.

gist.headline: Polli gets two doors
gist.blurb: Polli now keeps publishing commands behind the maintainer gate while opening a read-only question window for approved contributors. Same helpful bee, fewer accidental megaphones.
gist.summary: Split GitHub PR assistant commands so immutable-ID-approved maintainers can use !polli to publish replies, while the contributor allowlist can use the new !askpolli command for bounded-context, read-only PR questions via direct model inference.
gist.impact: Approved contributors, including fisventurous, can ask Polli about pull requests without reply-publishing access, while CI regression checks keep both authorization paths and workflows behaving as intended.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy repository garden has two clearly labeled little gates: a sturdy maintainer gate leading to a message-posting mailbox, and a friendly read-only question desk for contributors. Polli, wearing a tiny librarian hat, calmly directs question notes to a glowing terminal while code-vines and flowers represent bounded PR context; the monitor robot can hold a small approved-access list.
